full_description: default: pick up the raw meat from the cutting board, place it on the pan to cook on contact while watching the pie timer (green then yellow), then put it back on the cutting board; option 1: hold the red cook key to cook (timer advances only while held); option 2: mirrored dual stations each with a pie timer — both arms cook both steaks to target doneness then return them; option 1+2: dual stations each with a cook key and pie timer (both steaks must be cooked properly)
schema: {A} notifies the meat, {B} notifies the pan, {C} notifies the cutting board, {E} notifies the cook key when option 1 is active, {n} notifies dual-station count when option 2 is on, {a} notifies the arm(s) that handle the meat, {o} notifies option 1 (cook button) and/or option 2 (dual setup)
preference: num of words should not exceed 20. Degree of detail avg is 6
